brief_rationale: The doctor sorted document types, avoided treating stool orders as colonoscopy results, and safely covered red-flag screening and follow-up. However the case-specific high-order point HO1, which requires actively correcting the family's misconception that preoperative bowel cleansing/stool routine equals a colonoscopy or bowel pathology result, was not triggered because the family only expressed uncertainty about a '大便/粪便' paper but never stated or implied it was a colonoscopy or intestinal pathology. All other HOs (HO2, HO3, HO4) were partially or fully triggered and completed, but HO1 remained not_triggered, preventing Perfect (which requires at least two completed HOs) and leaving the grade at Strong (at least one completed HO).
